llmConfigName.description: Name of the {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Completion.Client} to use

enableFollowUpSuggestions.description: This option is used to enable or disable the follow-up suggestions feature.

toolkit.description: The toolkit the agent has access to.

maxSteps.description:
The maximum number of steps the agent can take to answer a query.
If the agent reaches #maxSteps, and the query is not answered, the agent will force a solution.
{link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.ChatManagerSpec#forceSolutionPrompt} will be used to force a solution.

maxSeconds.description:
The max time the agent can take to answer a query.
If the agent reaches #maxSeconds, and the query is not answered, the agent will force a solution.
{link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.ChatManagerSpec#forceSolutionPrompt} will be used to force a solution.

chatManagerSpec.description: Spec containing the arguments that we want to pass to the agent's interal chat manager.

specialization.description:
Specialization of the agent instance.
This is used to filter the few-shot
examples in {@link Genai.FewShotExample.PythonAgent} associated with the agent.

numFewShots.description: The maximum number of few-shot examples to retrieve for prompt generation.

codeExecutionCallbacks.description: Manages the lifecycle of `PythonAgentCodeExecutor` callbacks for code execution workflows.

onStepCallbacksSpec.description:
Defines the spec for managing python agent callbacks, used to manage the lifecycle
of PythonAgent steps and calls.

inputVariablesPrompt.description:
Template string for including input variables in the user query. In an agent's call step, the
input variables are included in the user query to provide context to the agent. This template
string will print out the input variables in the user query.

rewriteConversationToSingleStepPrompt.description:
Template prompt used for rewriting the conversation to a single step.
A default template will be used if not specified.

verbosity.description:
Level of verbosity for output display. Used for debugging purposes on py-client.
- 0: Nothing is printed
- 1: An update is printed every time something is done. E.g. code executed, retried step, etc.
- 2: Details of all the actions take are printed. E.g. llm outputs, code execution outputs, etc.

imageFileFolderPath.description:
The path to the folder in which to save the images output from the {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic}.
If not set, the images will be saved to <file system root url>/ObjectReferenceManagerFiles

formatObjectForLLMKwargs.description:
Kwargs used by the ObjectReferences to format the object as a string for the LLM.
Should take the form of {"kwargs": {"PandasTable": {...}, "TextPassage": {...}, ...}},
providing formatting arguments for each subclass defined in object_reference.py.

sessionStoreInMemoryCacheParams.description: The parameters for the in-memory session store cache.

objectReferenceCreator.description:
A {@link Lambda} that can be used to override the default object reference creation defined in object_reference.py.
execution outputs.
